findings.title: Search index lags ~10 minutes after team rename or member move
findings.description: After renaming a team or moving a member in the admin panel, search returns stale/old results (empty for the new team name, or old team for a moved member) for approximately 10 minutes before self-correcting with no user action required. Customer reproduced this on demand three separate times with consistent ~10 minute timing. During a large-scale reorg (60 members moved, 5 teams collapsed to 3 over two days), this caused a stream of 'where did this person go' tickets from managers who searched immediately after changes and concluded people had been deleted. The underlying edit/save operations (bulk move, rename) work correctly and do not lose data; only the search index is delayed. Workaround is waiting ~10 minutes for the index to catch up.
findings.quote: There's a real bug we hit over and over, and it's about search, not the editing. After we rename a team or move a member, search keeps returning the old state for about ten minutes.
findings.severity_reason: Real, reproducible defect causing confusion and support tickets during high-edit periods, but data is not lost, it self-corrects in ~10 minutes, and there is a known workaround (wait and re-search); customer explicitly says it is not urgent.
findings.match_note: Distinct from PROJ-131 (new invites not searchable until next day's index build): this is a ~10-minute lag on renames/moves for existing teams/members, not a next-day delay scoped to newly invited members.

findings.title: Mobile app truncates long team names aggressively with ellipsis
findings.description: On the mobile app, long team names are truncated with an ellipsis (e.g., 'Editorial Stra...'), making it hard to distinguish between similarly-named teams like 'Editorial Strategy' and 'Editorial Standards'. Desktop shows the full name; this is mobile-only. Customer explicitly frames it as purely cosmetic and says she is 'not really asking for anything,' and confirms no one has actually mis-acted on the wrong team because of it.
findings.quote: On my phone, in the mobile app, the team-name font truncates long names with an ellipsis really aggressively.
findings.severity_reason: Customer confirms it is a mild annoyance with no actual mix-ups caused, and is not requesting a change unless it later causes real confusion.
findings.match_note: No catalogue entry matches; not filed per customer's own framing as a non-request cosmetic observation.

findings.title: Positive feedback: bulk member-move and team-rename tools performed well under heavy load
findings.description: Customer moved roughly 60 members and renamed 5 teams into 3 over two days during a reorg. She reports the bulk move and rename operations themselves worked correctly with no errors and no data loss, and specifically praises the bulk-move flow for saving repetitive manual clicks.
findings.quote: The editing itself was fine, honestly. The bulk move worked, the renames worked, nothing errored out or lost data.
findings.severity_reason: Positive feedback about existing functionality working as intended; no defect or feature gap raised.
findings.match_note: Not a defect or feature request; included for reviewer visibility only, no catalogue action needed.
